headline: Slate EV Truck Under $25K with 205-mile range, launching late 2024
summary: The Slate EV truck starts at $24,950 with a 65-kWh battery pack and 2,000-pound tow rating.
details: The Slate EV truck is now available for preorder at $300, or $250 for existing reservation holders. First deliveries are expected at the end of 2024. The base 'Blank Slate' model features a 65-kWh battery pack, 205-mile range, and 2,000-pound tow rating.

The Slate EV truck comes with a 10-year or 110,000-mile warranty on its lithium iron phosphate battery and powertrain. The company has also partnered with over 3,000 RepairPal shops nationwide for maintenance and repairs.

The Slate EV truck will be built at a reindustrialized factory in Warsaw, Indiana, where the company plans to invest nearly $400 million in facilities. The truck's design is focused on simplicity, with a single color option and manual window winders.
